description.tr: Fas'ta Karaviyyîn'i kurdu (859) — Bologna ve Oxford'dan yüzyıllar önce, dünyanın en eski kesintisiz üniversitesi || Tüccar babasından miras aldığı servetiyle cami-üniversite kompleksi inşa etti. Karaviyyîn, Mağrib'in entelektüel merkezi oldu. || [Tarih notu] Hikâyesi, erken İslam medeniyetinde kadınların eğitim kurumlarının kurucuları ve hamileri olarak rolünü gösterir.
description.en: Founded al-Qarawiyyin in Fez (859 CE) — recognized as the oldest continuously operating university in the world, predating Bologna and Oxford by centuries || Fatima inherited wealth from her merchant father and invested it in building a mosque-university complex. Al-Qarawiyyin became the intellectual center of the Maghrib, training scholars who influenced all of North and West Africa. || [Historiographical note] Her story illustrates the role of women as founders and patrons of educational institutions in early Islamic civilization — a role often overlooked in conventional narratives.
description.ar: أسست جامعة القرويين في فاس (859م) — أقدم جامعة مستمرة في العالم || ورثت ثروة من أبيها التاجر واستثمرتها في بناء مجمع الجامع-الجامعة
